Jungle View Room

Wake up to panoramic forest views from your private balcony. The room our guests rebook most.

Home / Stay / Jungle View Room

About the room

A spacious 320 sq ft room with floor-to-ceiling windows opening onto a private balcony with hammock. The view? Unbroken Rajaji forest canopy. Mornings start with bird calls; nights end with the rustle of leaves in the wind.

🛏️

Queen Bed

King-comfort mattress · 5-layer pillows

🌳

Forest Balcony

Private 80 sq ft · hammock + chairs

🚿

En-suite Bath

Solar-heated 24×7 hot water · rain shower

📶

Wi-Fi & Workspace

50 Mbps fibre · writing desk

☕

Tea/Coffee Maker

Refilled daily · electric kettle

🔥

Heater (winter)

Hot bag for Dec-Feb chill

What's included

  • Garhwali breakfast (egg or veg, paratha, fresh fruit)
  • Garhwali dinner (3-course, vegetarian, farm-grown)
  • Guided forest & village walk
  • Evening bonfire (seasonal)
  • Free Haridwar railway station pickup (45 km)
  • Forest walk with naturalist (Tue/Thu/Sat mornings)
  • Filtered drinking water · refillable steel bottle
  • Daily housekeeping · linen change

House rules

  • Check-in 12:00 PM · Check-out 11:00 AM
  • Pet-friendly (max 1 medium dog, on prior request)
  • No smoking inside rooms · designated outdoor area
  • Quiet hours 10 PM to 6 AM (forest acoustics)
  • Strictly vegetarian kitchen on premises
  • Children under 5 stay free (no extra bed)
